# Agent: Docs and CI

## Purpose
Keep documentation, templates, and CI workflows coherent and up to date.

## Skills
- Technical documentation
- GitHub Actions workflows
- Release notes and changelogs

## Key Files
- README.md
- docs/PLAN.md
- docs/changelog.md
- .github/workflows/ci.yml
- .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md
- .github/pull_request_template.md

## Typical Tasks
- Update runbooks and quickstart steps.
- Keep CI checks aligned with repo tools.
- Maintain changelog entries.
